name: Abunai Onna no Ko to no Tsukiaikata
original_name: 危ない女の子との付き合い方
source:
In a new world of humans with supernatural powers, 
Masatsugu Tatsumi is forced to enroll in an all-supernatural school. 
Being comparatively powerless, anything could kill him. 
He survives countless dangers in the ordinary course of a day. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE181363.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在一个人类拥有超自然力量的新世界里，辰巳正继被迫进入一所全是超自然生物的学校。

相比之下，他的力量弱得可怜，任何事情都可能要了他的命。

他每天都在经历无数危险，只为活下去。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE181363.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
